title: AERO Script Shop
description:
Buy your AERO key in a private ticket.
**$9.00** — only you and the staff can see the ticket.
instructions:
1. Click **Open ticket**.
2. Select the **payment method** (Pix or PayPal).
3. Pay using the details shown in the ticket.
4. Send the receipt in the ticket.
5. A staff member delivers your key (you can also use `/deliver`).
6. Redeem it on the key panel and click **Get Script**.
